transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ___. What brings you in today?

I guess I'm here because... well, my house. Everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just about paperwork and missed payments. But... I know what's really going on. The bank, the loan servicer... even some people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out. 

I don't really want to get into all the details right now, but... I've been seeing it happen for almost two years. I don't care how many papers they try to show me to prove otherwise. I know what I see. So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Do you think it’s possible that your belief about the bank and your coworkers being involved could be mistaken?

No. I'm not mistaken. 

Like I said... I know what I see. They can wave all the paperwork they want in my face, but... it doesn't change anything. I've been watching them do this for two years. The bank, the people at work... I know they're doing it. I'm not wrong about this.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I sleep fine. Just the normal amount, I guess. I don't really get what that has to do with my house.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people could not?
No. ...I don't hear things. I don't know why you're asking me that. I just see what's right in front of me. That's all.
Outside of the foreclosure and your coworkers, have you had other beliefs that other people thought were clearly untrue?
No. I don't know what you mean by that. I just... I told you what's going on. That's it.
Have you ever had trouble with your thoughts feeling jumbled, hard to follow, or like they were not organized normally?
No. ...My thoughts are fine. I think perfectly clearly. I don't have any trouble like that.
Has there been any time when you considered that the foreclosure and work problems might have a more ordinary explanation, even briefly?

No. Why would I? Everyone keeps acting like... like it's just paperwork. Missed payments or whatever. But I know what's really happening. The bank, the loan servicer... even the people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out of my house. I've been seeing it happen for almost two years now. They can show me all the papers they want, but... it doesn't change what I know.
Has anyone directly told you that they are trying to force you out of your house?
No. They wouldn't just come out and say it. They're too careful for that.
Have you noticed any change in how well you’re functioning at work or taking care of daily responsibilities because of these beliefs?

I still do my job. ...I get up, I supervise my team, handle the schedules and the customer issues. I take care of myself. Everything is normal. 

It's really only... well, things only get complicated if I get certain mail, or if the bank calls. Or... if they give me paperwork at work that I know is tied to what they're doing with my house. But otherwise, no. I function fine.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you felt unusually irritable or euphoric and more active than usual?
No. ...I don't get like that. I just do my normal routine.
Have you ever had trouble telling whether things people say or do are meant for you specifically?
No. ...I don't really know what you mean by that. I know when someone is talking to me. I don't get confused about it.
Have you ever had any experiences where you heard a voice when no one was there?
No. I don't hear things.
Have you had any other beliefs that turned out to be untrue, outside of the foreclosure and work situation?
No. ...I don't have anything else. Just what I already told you. And I'm not wrong about the situation at work, anyway. But no, nothing else.
Do you think anyone is trying to harm you or spy on you?
No. ...Nobody is spying on me. I don't have people following me or anything like that.
Have your beliefs about the foreclosure or your coworkers caused you to miss work, quit a job, or struggle to keep up with your usual responsibilities?

No. I still get up and go to work. I supervise my team, handle the schedules and the customers... I take care of myself just fine. It's not a problem unless... well, if there's mail, or the bank calls, or if certain paperwork at work seems tied to what they're doing with the house. That's when things get difficult. But otherwise, no. I do my job.
Have you ever thought that ordinary events on TV, online, or in the news were sending you special messages meant specifically for you?
No. I don't... I just watch normal TV. I don't think the news is talking to me. It's just the news.
Have you had any other strong beliefs like this that aren’t about the house or your job?
No. ...I don't really know what else you're looking for. Just what I already told you about the house. That's it.
Have you ever believed that people, events, or messages unrelated to your house or job were connected to you in a special way?
No. I... I just said that. It's only about the house. I don't know why you keep asking the same kind of thing.
Do you ever think that unrelated everyday events are specifically connected to you or your situation?
I... I really don't understand why you're asking me this again. The answer is still no. It's just what's going on with my house. I don't have anything else to say about it.
Have you ever had any other fixed beliefs that other people found completely unbelievable, outside of the house and work situation?
No. ...I don't know how many different ways I can answer this. I don't have any other... beliefs. There's nothing else to tell you.
